text: The island tells its stories. Leave it alone for a few seconds, or press Watch, and the camera goes to what is happening: a wolf after a deer, a guard fighting a bear, a tavern going up, a fisher at the shore. It stays close enough to see who is who, and one line says what you are looking at. Villagers have names now. Tap the island to get your view back, or drag to stay where the story is. When something big happens while you are busy, a line shows on the island: tap it to go there. A tapped creature's card has a Follow button.
